fromReplays: From the replays saved on this PC
noActivity: Your next match starts the story.
overlayHint: Add this address as an OBS Browser Source. Size: 420 × 120.
noMatches: No matches yet. Open the companion and play a match with replay recording enabled.
folderHint: Windows companion required. Leave the default unless your replays are elsewhere.
step1Body: In Fortnite: Settings → Game → Replays → Record Replays → On.
step2Body: Burnaviour Chest Tracker reads your saved replays and counts a few seconds after each match ends.
step3Body: Copy the overlay URL into an OBS Browser Source (420 × 120). Keep the tracker running.
privacy: Reads your local replay files only. Nothing is uploaded. No game memory access. Not affiliated with Epic Games.
creator: Support with creator code
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
invalidCount: Enter a whole number from 0 to 2,147,483,647.
historyNotice: The first count uses replays saved on this PC, often around 100 matches. It is not your full season or career total. Enter your known total or best estimate; new chests will count upward from it. Clear the starting count to use recorded replay totals.
runtimeHelp: The tracker is running. Microsoft WebView2 is unavailable, so use the browser dashboard or install the runtime and retry.
huntNote: Counts the chests in the replays saved on this PC since the hunt began on 1 Nov. Chests from before your oldest saved replay are not included.
oddsNote: Epic's published odds per chest. Weekly treasure uses this week's chests; Pirate Shop Access and Gizmos use the whole hunt. Chests opened in a Treasure Hour count with the boosted odds of the first Treasure Hours.
planEndWeek: Your chance by the end of the week
planNote: At your pace of {perDay} chests a day played, that's about {more} more chests before then.
planNoPace: Play a match to see what your own pace gets you.
noFinds: No treasure found in your saved replays yet.
seeTreasure: See this week's treasure on burnaviour.dev
gameOverlay: Show the counter over the game
gameOverlayHint: A small always-on-top counter, no OBS needed. Set Fortnite to Windowed Fullscreen (it cannot draw over exclusive Fullscreen). Drag it where you want, then press Ctrl+Shift+L to lock it so clicks pass through. Ctrl+Shift+O shows or hides it.
fullscreenWarning: Fortnite is set to Fullscreen, so the counter cannot show over it. In Fortnite: Settings → Video → Window Mode → Windowed Fullscreen, then Apply.
